observations: body L1-L2: the half-title. The display faces of the print are not imitated: each line is set in the roman of the edition and scaled to a box as wide and as high as the printed line, both enlarged in the ratio of the measures (532.9 to 424.4 pt); the rules are enlarged in the same ratio and keep their printed thickness. «sive» is in small capitals. The macrons of «AL-BATTĀNĪ» print broken, each in two pieces. A speck touches the top of the N of «ALBATENII»; a dot on the baseline between the I and the C of «ASTRONOMICUM» is a speck, not a stop. L2 ends without a stop.
body: the rule under L2 (73.2 pt long and 0.5 pt thick in the print) is printed broken near its right end; it is drawn whole.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
